title: Purpose.
bodyText: It is the policy and the purpose of this chapter to insure that only qualified persons be allowed to practice in the fields of speech pathology and audiology.
bodyHtml: §468E-1  Purpose.  It is the policy and the purpose of this chapter to insure that only qualified persons be allowed to practice in the fields of speech pathology and audiology. [L 1974, c 48, pt of §1; am L 1988, c 320, §2]
